title: IDF Says It Killed Three Hamas Operatives in Weekend Gaza Strikes, Including Two October 7 Infiltrators
detail: The IDF and Shin Bet said Sunday, September 20, 2026 that they killed three Hamas operatives in strikes across the Gaza Strip over the weekend: Yahya Hamdouna, a Hamas member who invaded Israel on October 7, 2023, killed Saturday; Mohammad Rafa'i, a member of Hamas's Daraj-Tuffah Battalion who also invaded Israel on October 7; and Basir al-Barsh, a Nukhba Force commander killed in a strike in the northern Jabalia refugee camp area. Palestinian media separately identified al-Barsh as the son of Munir al-Bursh, director-general of Gaza's Hamas-run health ministry. The IDF and Shin Bet said in a joint statement that all three had been 'advancing attacks on troops and Israeli civilians, and acting to restore Hamas's capabilities, in systematic violation of the ceasefire,' and were killed 'to remove the threat.' The strikes followed a Thursday, September 17 strike in Khan Younis that killed Hamas commander Muhammad Suleiman Byouk, another October 7 participant.

title: INSS Survey: 75% of Israelis, Including Majority of Coalition Voters, Back State Commission of Inquiry into October 7
detail: A Haaretz analysis published Sunday, September 20, 2026 by Amos Harel, examining how Israel remains divided over October 7 accountability as the third anniversary and the October 27 election approach, cited a new Institute for National Security Studies (INSS) survey finding that 75% of Israelis support establishing a state commission of inquiry into the attack, with support crossing political lines — 52% of coalition voters also back the probe. An INSS researcher cited in the piece said Israel's current security posture is 'not sustainable over time.' The finding echoes earlier polling (Hebrew University 72% in April, JPPI 63% in May) showing sustained majority demand for an independent inquiry that the government has not established nearly three years after the attack.
